fixtures.name: ag
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id, (k % 10)::INTEGER AS g, (k % 3)::INTEGER AS g3,
  (CASE k % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'north' WHEN 1 THEN 'south' WHEN 2 THEN NULL ELSE 'east' END) AS gs,
  (CASE WHEN k % 10 = 9 THEN NULL
        WHEN k % 10 = 0 THEN true
        WHEN k % 10 = 1 THEN false
        WHEN k % 10 = 3 THEN (CASE WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE true END)
        WHEN k % 10 = 4 THEN (CASE WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE false END)
        ELSE (k % 3 = 0) END) AS b,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 7919) % 2001 - 1000) END)::INTEGER AS i,
  (CASE WHEN k % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 104729) % 4000000007 - 2000000003) * 1000 END)::BIGINT AS big,
  (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 37) % 20011) / 8.0 - 1000 END)::DOUBLE AS f,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 53) % 3001) / 4.0 - 300 END)::FLOAT AS fl,
  (CASE WHEN k % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 977) % 2000001 - 1000000) / 100.0 END)::DECIMAL(9,2) AS d2,
  (CASE WHEN k % 8 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 1234567) % 2000000001 - 1000000000) / 10000.0 END)::DECIMAL(18,4) AS d4,
  (CASE WHEN k % 15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'w' || ((k * 31) % 97)::VARCHAR END) AS s,
  (CASE WHEN k % 19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE '1990-01-01' + ((k * 37) % 12000)::INTEGER END) AS dt,
  (CASE WHEN k % 21 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00' + to_seconds(((k * 7919) % 900000000)::BIGINT) END) AS ts
FROM range(0, 3000) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 500)

fixtures.name: agv
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id, (k % 12)::INTEGER AS g,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 < 6 THEN 1e9 + ((k * 37) % 1001) / 1000.0
        WHEN k % 12 = 6 THEN (CASE WHEN k % 24 = 6 THEN 'NaN'::DOUBLE ELSE (k % 7)::DOUBLE END)
        WHEN k % 12 = 7 THEN (CASE WHEN k = 7 THEN 'Infinity'::DOUBLE ELSE 1.5 + (k % 5) END)
        WHEN k % 12 = 8 THEN (CASE WHEN k = 8 THEN '-Infinity'::DOUBLE WHEN k = 20 THEN 'Infinity'::DOUBLE ELSE 2.0 END)
        WHEN k % 12 = 9 THEN NULL
        WHEN k % 12 = 10 THEN (CASE WHEN k = 10 THEN 42.5 ELSE NULL END)
        ELSE 3.14 END)::DOUBLE AS v,
  (CASE WHEN k % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 1099511627776 + (k * 7919) % 1000003 END)::BIGINT AS big,
  (CASE WHEN k % 14 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 9223372036854775808 + (k * 104729) % 100003 * 1000003 END)::UBIGINT AS ub,
  (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (k * 7919) % 65536 - 32768 END)::SMALLINT AS sm,
  (CASE WHEN k % 12 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 53) % 3001) / 4.0 - 300 END)::FLOAT AS fl,
  (CASE WHEN k % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 977) % 2000001 - 1000000) / 100.0 END)::DECIMAL(9,2) AS d2,
  (CASE WHEN k % 8 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((k * 104729) % 2000000000001 - 1000000000000) / 1000.0 END)::DECIMAL(18,3) AS d18,
  (CASE WHEN k % 10 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (((k * 7919)::HUGEINT * 123456789012345678 % 10000000000000000000000000000000) - 5000000000000000000000000000000)::DECIMAL(38,6) END) AS d38,
  (CASE WHEN k % 4 = 0 THEN 'north' WHEN k % 4 = 1 THEN 'south' WHEN k % 4 = 2 THEN NULL ELSE 'east' END) AS gs,
  (CASE WHEN k % 15 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'w' || ((k * 31) % 97)::VARCHAR END) AS s,
  (CASE WHEN k % 19 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE '1990-01-01' + ((k * 37) % 12000)::INTEGER END) AS dt,
  (k % 5 = 0) AS b
FROM range(0, 2400) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 400)
